You will be responsible for screening initial applications through Greenhouse, managing our internal scheduling tools, and assisting with the onboarding process for new hires within BambooHR. Your daily duties include updating employee records, answering general HR inquiries, and maintaining documentation accuracy. In the first six months, you will work closely with our HR manager to master our administrative systems and contribute to the efficiency of our hiring workflows. You will collaborate frequently with the recruitment team to ensure candidates have a positive experience from the first interaction. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn the end-to-end HR lifecycle and grow into a more specialized operational or talent acquisition function. We are looking for an individual who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and excited about building their foundational knowledge in HR technologies. Success in this role means taking ownership of your administrative responsibilities, demonstrating a proactive attitude toward learning our internal tools, and helping the team maintain a high level of compliance and efficiency. We offer a supportive, collaborative environment where your contributions will directly impact the employee experience.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Lead
raw_text: Our Talent team of twenty is seeking a Senior Talent Acquisition Lead to drive our strategic hiring efforts across all engineering and product departments. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for scaling our global recruitment infrastructure, managing our enterprise-level Workday instance, and overseeing a team of twelve recruiters. Your responsibilities include developing end-to-end talent sourcing strategies, ensuring high-quality candidate pipelines, and implementing advanced data analytics to track performance and diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) metrics. You will be expected to leverage SAP SuccessFactors for process optimization and collaborate with executive leadership to forecast hiring needs for the next fiscal year. In the first six months, you will perform a comprehensive audit of our existing hiring processes and introduce automated workflows to improve team efficiency. You will work closely with the data team to develop sophisticated reporting dashboards and with product managers to define talent requirements for future development cycles. This position offers significant scope to influence company-wide growth and build a best-in-class recruitment department. Success means demonstrating deep subject matter expertise, achieving aggressive hiring targets, and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability within your team. We are looking for a strategic thinker who is passionate about talent development and comfortable leading complex teams in a fast-paced environment.

title: Principal HR Operations Lead
raw_text: The HR Operations department is currently looking for a Principal HR Operations Lead to overhaul our enterprise-wide talent infrastructure. Our team of fifteen professionals is dedicated to building scalable, automated, and compliant HR processes that support a global organization of 5,000 employees. You will be responsible for leading the integration of our complex HRIS ecosystem, including Workday and SAP SuccessFactors, and directing our overarching talent acquisition and recruitment strategy. Your day-to-day duties include auditing compliance with labor laws, managing large-scale process automation projects, and ensuring the stability and performance of our recruitment tools like Greenhouse. You will mentor senior-level staff, collaborate with the IT and finance teams to ensure technical alignment, and provide strategic recommendations to the executive board regarding workforce planning and operational scalability. In the first six months, you will be expected to complete a major migration of our talent infrastructure and implement a new, data-driven reporting system for global recruitment efficiency. We are looking for a seasoned professional with a deep passion for HR technology and organizational growth. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of our operations and drive systemic change that impacts every member of the organization. Success is defined by your ability to improve operational efficiency, ensure total compliance, and maintain a high-performing and motivated department.
